summary: HelmCharts 93626fc on phase/023-P5 adds the backup-freshness rule group to the prd Prometheus release. BackupOverdue fires per scope/filename past valid-until. BackupWatcherBlind fires once no scrape in 6 h reported a successful read, covering a target down or gone and a crash loop. Both are critical with a shared 6 h look-back, and a new simulation test evaluates them; kc project test is green. The plan's done-record, the P6/P7 edits and close-out S4 plus a Q1 note are committed in AnsibleSpecs.
